title: VWP Fact
description: An extracted or computed observation supported by evidence. Facts are observations, not conclusions.

factType.description: Optional namespaced type for the fact (e.g. 'asc606.transactionPrice'). Extensions may declare fact types and validate 'value' against a declared shape, and may require specific fact types for a work product type.

value.description: Optional structured value for the fact (number, string, boolean, or object). See spec/facts.md for conventional shapes (money, quantity, period).

anchors.description: Locations inside the cited evidence, one anchor per chunk. Fields within an anchor compose to describe a single chunk; multiple chunks are multiple anchors.

evidenceRefs.description: References to supporting evidence: either a bare evidence id, or an object with anchors locating the observation inside the evidence. The file itself is addressed by the evidence object the id resolves to (its path/sha256), never by the anchor.

extractionMethod.description: How the fact was obtained, e.g. 'manual', 'deterministic-parser', 'model-extraction'.

extractionModel.description: When a model extracted this fact, the exact model used. Lets reviewers challenge model-extracted facts with a different model than the one that produced them.

name.description: Exact model identifier as published by the provider, not a family or marketing name.

anchor.description: Locates one chunk of the referenced evidence. All fields optional and composable; 'quote' enables deterministic verification against text evidence, the rest are advisory locators.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the evidence supporting the fact. For text evidence, verifiers check (after whitespace/punctuation normalization) that the quote appears in the evidence bytes.

lines.description: 1-based line range. When 'page' is also set, lines are relative to that page (a pin cite: page 7, lines 12-14); otherwise they are global to the text evidence.

range.description: A1-style cell or range, e.g. 'B7' or 'B7:D9'.

charSpan.description: 0-based character offsets into text evidence, end-exclusive.

byteRange.description: 0-based byte offsets into the evidence bytes, end-exclusive.

section.description: Human-readable section/clause label, e.g. '2(a)' or 'Article IV'.
